verdict.rationale: Helicone's own Alerts feature monitors error rates and costs on LLM requests, supports filters, and notifies through Slack or email. Alerts are also listed as a paid-tier feature. However, the evidence says nothing about alerting on eval-score drops or a PagerDuty channel. missing for 10: eval-score-drop alerts, PagerDuty notification channel, explicit spike/threshold configuration details, independent hands-on corroboration of alerting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops and get notified in Slack, PagerDuty, or email

citations.quote: Helicone Alerts let you monitor error rates and costs on LLM requests to catch issues before they impact users.
Each alert can be configured with filters and automatically notify through channels like Slack or email.
